description: POST action=create_order — line_user_id resolves to an existing user (so the 'User not found' branch is NOT hit), but cart_items is an empty array so the server falls through to loadCheckoutCartLinesFromDb() (L1364-1367), which also returns no rows for this user's cart_items — handleCreateOrder() fails fast with 'Cart is empty' (L1369-1371) before ever opening the DB transaction (no transactions/transaction_items rows are written).
